At scale 3, all 36804 faces are enumerated, 18399 disjoint matched incidences form a globally acyclic discrete-Morse matching, leaving one 0-cell and five 5-cells, so wedge of five S5; scales 0 and >=4 follow from isolates/diameter. Independent checks inspect actual package claims; no infinity inference.
